<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Read the input file
input_file = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Perform KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
df['cluster_id'] = kmeans.fit_predict(df['indicator_values'])

# Create the cluster assignments file
city_clusters = pd.DataFrame({
    'city_id': df.index,
    'city_name': df['city_name'],
    'year': df['year'],
    'cluster_id': df['cluster_id']
})
city_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False)

# Calculate mean values for each cluster
cluster_profiles = pd.DataFrame({
    'cluster_id': df['cluster_id'].unique(),
    'mean_value': df.groupby('cluster_id')['indicator_values'].mean()
})
cluster_profiles.to_csv('outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>

df['cluster_id'] = kmeans.fit_predict(df['indicator_values'])

# Create the cluster assignments file

    'city_id': df.index,
    'city_name': df['city_name'],
    'year': df['year'],
    'cluster_id': df['cluster_id']
})
city_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False)

cluster_profiles = pd.DataFrame({
    'cluster_id': df['cluster_id'].unique(),
    'mean_value': df.groupby('cluster_id')['indicator_values'].mean()
